summary: TNL Mediagene furnished a Form -6K reporting completion of its Japan Business Sale to MI Company Inc., an acquisition vehicle led by former CEO Motoko Imada, under a Share Purchase Agreement dated September 30, 2026. Aggregate consideration was $5.5 million: roughly $3.85 million cash, ~$0.15 million via intercompany-debt set-off, and $1.5 million through extinguishment of Company promissory notes, subject to a net-debt adjustment capped at $500,000. The sale was vetted by an independent Special Committee, backed by an Imperial Capital fairness opinion and Board approval. Imada and other officers resigned at closing. Watch post-closing Nasdaq equity compliance and residual Taiwan operations.
